blocks.cap: The FIRST and ONLY Family Cinema in the country is now open in Opus Premier Cinemas

blocks.html: Enjoy the newest and most luxurious way to watch movies at Opus Premier Cinemas.
The largest VIP screen in the country, a colorful child-friendly cinema—Opus Premier Cinemas will elevate your trip to the movies.

Opus Premier Cinemas’ VIP Cinema features a 15-meter screen, the largest screen you’ll find in any VIP cinema in the country. The VIP Cinema utilizes Dolby Atmos Digital sound system and laser projection technology to give you a fully immersive experience. Watch new releases while relaxing on fully reclining leather seats with privacy cocoons—perfect for date night! The seats are equipped with a USB charging port and service table.
Arrived too early for your movie? Wait for it at the elegant VIP Cinema Lounge, where you can unwind and dine in style before your screening starts.

Bring your kids, grandkids, nieces, nephews and inaanaks to Opus Premier Cinemas’ Family Cinema—the first and only cinema of its kind in the country. This colorful, comfy, and fun cinema allows kids to be kids, giving them the freedom to enjoy the movie while sitting on plush couches. Focusing on delivering the perfect movie experience for young moviegoers, this cinema uses a child-friendly sound system and ambient lighting—and the cinema even smells like bubblegum!
This cinema also has a 15-meter screen and utilizes laser projection technology and Dolby 7.1 sound system. These are also available in the other 3 Opus Cinemas.

blocks.cap: Complete your movie-watching experience with freshly popped popcorn from the Snack Bar

blocks.html: Snacks are an essential part of the moviegoing experience and at Opus Premier Cinemas’ Snack area, you’ll find yummy options along with soda. Of course, popcorn is a must and they have it available in five flavors: butter, cheese, BBQ, sour cream and coming soon, salted caramel!

blocks.cap: Relax while you wait for your screening at The VIP Cinema Lounge

blocks.html: It doesn’t matter what genre you’re into, you’re bound to have a great time at Opus Premier Cinemas.
You can find Opus Premier Cinemas at Level 5 of Opus Mall in Bridgetowne Quezon City.
